# *European AI4CI Master Artificial Intelligence for Connected Industries*

The AI4CI master is a European master opened at [Conservatoire national des arts et métiers (Cnam)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Conservatoire_national_des_arts_et_métiers), Paris downtown, France, as well as in Mulhouse, France, and at partner universities in Avignon, and in Germany, Romania, Spain, Ukraine.

The master training program covers:

* fundamentals of **artificial intelligence** and machine learning applied to networked systems.
* **applied robotics** for industrial connected systems;
* advanced **network architectures, IoT and computer systems**;

The master teachers include world-class academics from our european partners and industry experts active in the master technical areas on international, European and national collaborative industrial research projects (H2020, ANR), standardization and open-source bodies (ONF, IETF, ETSI).

The master is opened in the following European cities across which mobility for 1 or 2 semesters is supported by the Erasmus+ framework:

* Paris, France, at Cnam Paris – applications via this website and Campus France.
* Mulhouse, France, at Cnam Grand-Est, in apprenticeship – applications via [TMM](http://monmaster.gouv.fr) ([more details](https://master-alt.roc.cnam.fr)).
* Avignon, at [Avignon Université](https://www.bing.com/ck/a?!&&p=1629d9a92a3c683fJmltdHM9MTY5NzE1NTIwMCZpZ3VpZD0zZDUwZDI1OS04YThmLTYxYzgtMjVkZi1jMWZmOGI4OTYwYWEmaW5zaWQ9NTIyMQ&ptn=3&hsh=3&fclid=3d50d259-8a8f-61c8-25df-c1ff8b8960aa&psq=avignon+universit%c3%a9&u=a1aHR0cHM6Ly91bml2LWF2aWdub24uZnIv&ntb=1) (France).
* Barcelona, at [Universitat Politècnica de Catalunya](https://www.upc.edu/en) (Spain).
* Cluj-Napoca, at [Universitatea Babeș-Bolyai](https://www.ubbcluj.ro/en/) (Romania).
* Kiev, at [National Technical University of Ukraine](https://kpi.ua/en) (Ukraine).
* Ulm, at [University of Ulm](https://www.uni-ulm.de/en/) (Germany).

and integrates courses and traineeships offered and taught by personnel from companies and other universities:

* [Eclexys](http://eclexys.com) (Switzerland),
* [Green Communications](http://green-communications.fr) (France),
* [International Hellenic University](https://www.ihu.gr/en/enhome) (Greece),
* [I2CAT](http://i2cat.net) (Spain),
* [ITCL](https://itcl.es/en/) (Spain),
* [SMILE](https://www.smile.eu/en) (France),
* [U-Hopper](http://u-hopper.com) (Italy),
* [Università di Pisa](https://www.unipi.it/) (Italy).

Besides point teaching from experts from Ericsson, Orange, Thales. The AI4CI can benefit from cloud computing and publishing services from [TANHOST](https://www.tanhost.com) and [KMB](https://kmbooks.com.ua) (Ukraine).

The AI4CI master is co-funded by the European Commission, [Digital Europe Programme](https://digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/activities/digital-programme), managed by [HADEA](http://hadea.ec.europa.eu) (contract nb: [101123524](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/how-to-participate/org-details/883736349/project/101123524/program/43152860/details)). More information on the AI4CI project can be found at [ai4ci.eu](https://ai4ci.eu).

On the right-side widget: recent publications from master teachers.

## Training objectives

The AI4CI addresses a critical challenge facing the whole European industry sector: the need for professionals with expertise in Artificial Intelligence (AI) applied to connected industries. As AI continues to transform industries across the globe, shortage of professionals with these skills may lay in the critical path towards a competitive EU stance at the industrial level. To address this challenge, the AI4CI  
project proposes to create a new teaching program focused on AI for connected industries. By developing the master’s programs, the project aims to provide students and professionals with a well-rounded education that prepares them for the challenges and opportunities of this rapidly-evolving field.
